basics.name: Ridwan Amure
basics.label: PhD Candidate | Machine Learning & Computational Social Science Researcher
basics.summary: PhD candidate specializing in cross-platform narrative diffusion, machine learning, and computational social science. Experienced in ML engineering, NLP pipelines, and socio-technical behavior modeling.

work.company: University of Arkansas at Little Rock
work.summary: Lead research efforts on cyber behaviors through social media analysis, with focus on mechanisms and structures of cross-platform narrative diffusion.
highlights: Led end-to-end research on cyber behaviors via social media analysis.
Studied mechanisms and entities involved in cross-platform narrative diffusion.
Developed multiplatform knowledge graph embeddings and ML models to extract insights.

work.summary: Worked on ranking models and training pipelines to improve model deployment and retrieval performance.
highlights: Built a training data pipeline reducing activity-to-serving time from 14 days to 1 day.
Implemented step-changes in model-based retrieval using feature ablation and new model architectures.
Implemented transformer-only interaction architecture for ranking models.

work.summary: Developed NLP and Bayesian modeling tools to improve medical risk adjustment and coding accuracy.
highlights: Developed NLP pipelines for risk adjustment improving accuracy and efficiency.
Designed Bayesian models to detect suboptimal codings in medical records.
Managed end-to-end ML lifecycle from preprocessing to deployment.
Led engineering team to build a comprehensive risk adjustment platform.

work.summary: Designed scalable NLP systems using transformer architectures and developed production ML microservices.
highlights: Implemented transformer-based NLP pipelines for NER and extraction.
Developed microservices for model serving using Docker, AWS, Jenkins, Kubernetes.
Supported end-to-end project development with strong documentation practices.

work.summary: Built high-accuracy computer vision models for agricultural applications serving over 200,000 farmers.
highlights: Developed low-latency, high-accuracy computer vision models for crop condition detection.
Researched and designed ML/AI applications for agricultural intelligence.
Maintained production CV models and supported field operations.
